newsitem.title: CHINA: China Telecom signs MOU for $1.2 bln cable to U.S..
newsitem.headline: China Telecom signs MOU for $1.2 bln cable to U.S..

text.p: China Telecom on Sunday signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with nine companies from the United States and elsewhere for a $1.2 billion cross-Pacific undersea cable project, the Xinhua news agency said.
China Telecom signed with AT&T Corp, Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, MCI Communications Corp, SBC Communications Inc, Sprint Corp, and Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co, Ltd Xinhua said.
Telecommunications companies from South Korea, Singapore and Hong Kong made up the remainder of the 10 companies involved in the MOU signing, the official agency said.

Other firms were welcome to join the project to lay the optical cable, which would be capable of carrying more than 241,920 telephone lines between China and the United States, it quoted a China Telecom official as saying.
China Telecom is the commercial arm of China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.
Work on the project would start this year and was scheduled to be completed by the end of 1999, Xinhua said.
The undersea cable would link with other international telecommunications routes, it said but gave no details.
